# openmetadata_user Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata user by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_user" "jane" {
  fully_qualified_name = "jane.doe"
}

output "jane_user_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_user.jane.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) User fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) User UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `default_persona` (String) Fully qualified name of the user's default persona.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an administrator.
- `is_bot` (Boolean) Whether the user backs an OpenMetadata bot.
- `name` (String) User name.
- `roles` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the roles assigned to the user.
- `teams` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the teams the user belongs to.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone of the user.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
